source: Independent direct aggregation of twelve runs-XX.csv files; no analysis function or simulator imported or run.

BL_validation.pathwise_limit: Stored action hashes do not reveal their action sequence. This audit directly verifies final per-arm counts and cap legality, and previously reviewed the chooser and runtime availability guard. It does not independently recover every action time from the hash.

limitations: Intervals are paired Student t screening intervals, not distribution-free confidence bounds.
This uses an already studied holdout suite and is not a fresh confirmatory experiment.
Equal scenario weighting describes this fixed suite; horizons and gap scales differ by scenario.
The duplicate beta0.5/beta1 methods must not be counted as independent evidence or distinct wins.
